card_limitations: Schema inference is not a financial data-quality contract. Validate precision, timezones and schema drift.
Watermark-only extraction can miss late revisions; use bounded overlap, deduplication and immutable capture. The hub extra is separate from the basic local pipeline.
candidates.name: data-dlt
candidates.role: Python extraction/loading pipelines with local DuckDB destination

card_limitations: Catalog creation alone would not prove append, multi-writer conflict handling, cross-engine compatibility or time travel.
Snapshot expiry and orphan-file removal must preserve required research/audit versions; storage snapshots do not imply past information availability.
candidates.name: data-iceberg
candidates.role: Open table snapshots and schema/partition evolution

card_limitations: Application path must identify code prepared separately; the command is not a turnkey financial service.
Cluster control APIs are powerful; do not expose to untrusted networks.
No distributed performance or failover acceptance performed.
candidates.name: ray-serve

card_limitations: Native evidence covers six bundled historical simulation events, three order IDs, Parquet reread and one XNYS session; it proves neither market-data ingestion nor live trading.
ASOF join alone cannot remove revised fundamentals or reconstruct unavailable historical universes.
Decimal/timestamp schemas and immutable snapshot selection are application responsibilities.

The later Dagu workflow prepared six fresh bundled-simulation order events and a cited packet; standalone Claude report acceptance is separate from the unexecuted allowance-blocked paired Astra-to-Claude graph.

The SEC recipe passed offline artificial-fixture temporal, amendment, unit and DECIMAL(38,12) boundary checks. Its first official SEC request returned HTTP 403: no live SEC source payload, Parquet dataset or ready financial packet was obtained.
candidates.name: DuckDB
candidates.role: Embedded SQL over immutable Parquet research snapshots

card_limitations: Catalog did not install/start a server. Enterprise features and managed hosting have separate terms.
Dedup/upsert can overwrite corrections; retain a raw immutable ledger before serving latest state.
candidates.name: QuestDB
candidates.role: SQL time-series server with ingestion and temporal joins

card_limitations: Local SQL command is prospective; no server, cluster, throughput or reliability evidence was created.
Eventual background merges/deduplication must not be mistaken for an immutable revision ledger or globally exactly-once external effects.
candidates.name: ClickHouse
candidates.role: Columnar analytical database and local query utility

card_limitations: Arrow is an interchange format/library, not a historical security master or data service.
Parquet encodings and time units can be lost or coerced across conversions; verify round-trip precision.
candidates.name: data-arrow
candidates.role: Typed columnar interchange and Parquet IO

card_limitations: Schema validation is not provider completeness, correct corporate actions, accurate prices or absence of leakage.
The demonstration checks synthetic keys/quantities only; real market schemas and fail-closed promotion are still implementation work.
pandera-dev/pandera currently redirects to canonical unionai-oss/pandera.
candidates.name: Pandera
candidates.role: Dataframe schemas and validation before snapshot promotion

candidates.name: bytebase/dbhub
candidates.note: An actual curated research database existing, plus a demonstrated read-only principal and bounded max_rows enforcement, making an MCP bridge cheaper than direct DuckDB access.

card_limitations: Native proof is one encode/decode fixture roundtrip, not generalized token savings. Not universally smaller than JSON, especially nested or irregular records. Not an order-message protocol replacement.
candidates.name: foundation-toon

card_limitations: Event-time point-in-time retrieval does not automatically exclude a late correction learned after the historical decision.
Materialization freshness, feature skew, access control and outage fallback require separate operational evidence.
candidates.name: data-feast
candidates.role: Historical feature retrieval and online/offline feature definitions

existing_overturn_when: Freeze required universe/history/latency, rights, correction and availability semantics; compare selected providers on representative securities including delistings, ticker reuse and corporate actions, then change the feed/store only when a candidate closes those gaps with auditable records and acceptable measured cost. Add a server or lake only after local throughput/concurrency measurements justify it.
limitations: The authenticated Alpaca receipt covers 25 AAPL SIP/raw daily bars and two corporate actions over five successful pages, not a survivorship-free universe, complete history or real-time feed entitlement.

Numeric corporate-action values matched the frozen probe, but missing dividend currency prevented full cash-unit reconciliation. Original historical availability and complete action coverage remain open.
Three documentary lifecycle cases preserve observed cutoffs and source anchors; retrospective claims do not establish historical as-known eligibility or permanent security identity.
The prior SEC HTTP 403 remains a historical failure. Later corrected acquisition and parsing qualify their selected requests only; no general filing-completeness or strategy-validity claim follows.
SQL, schemas and content hashes cannot repair missing provenance, revised fundamentals, access rights or outcome-selected samples.
The us-equities catalog also tags entries for this taxonomy layer under foundation-memory (1), agents-operations (1); data-research (11) was picked as the primary group by entry count.
requirement: Acquire licensed, source-identifiable US-equity observations; preserve feed, timestamps, identity and corporate actions; produce exact reproducible analytical snapshots and reject data whose historical availability or eligibility is unknown.
requirement_note: The requirement, limitations and existing_overturn_when text is shared by this layer's group; judge fit against the layer title and layer_scope_terms.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
